q1.question: Is Money Tracker free to use?
q1.answer: Yes. Money Tracker is a personal, self-hosted tool that runs on your own machine at no cost.

q2.question: Where is my financial data stored?
q2.answer: Everything stays in your own local database. Your data never leaves your machine and is never sent to third parties.

q3.question: Can I import my existing transactions?
q3.answer: Yes. You can import transactions from CSV or JSON files, so you can get started without re-entering months of history.

q4.question: Can I organize transactions into categories?
q4.answer: Absolutely. You can build a category hierarchy and assign every transaction, then view detailed breakdowns by category.

q5.question: Does Money Tracker support more than one language?
q5.answer: Yes. The interface is fully available in English and Ukrainian, and you can switch languages at any time.
